verified_picks.reason: Three refutations. First, seniority is in the title and the URL slug: 'Senior Analyst'. The rubric treats that as a disqualifier on its own, and Deloitte India Senior Analyst conventionally sits at 2-4 years. The body's 'ideal for early-career professionals' line contradicts the grade, and when a JD body and a grade disagree, the grade is what the ATS and the staffing manager screen on. Second, the original scored the gate and ignored the job. The work profile is explicit: 'a motivated and detail-oriented Cloud Security & Cloud Governance Analyst ... support cloud security operations, governance initiatives, compliance activities, and security monitoring across cloud environments such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)'. The skills list is CSPM tooling, IAM configuration and role-assignment review, Microsoft Defender for Cloud / AWS Security Hub / Azure Policy / AWS Config, SIEM, vulnerability management, ISO 27001 / SOC 2 / CIS Benchmarks / PCI DSS / GDPR, networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs) and 'Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems'. He has none of that. GitLane's raw TCP sockets is not networking-as-a-discipline and will not survive two questions. Third, the original oversold the cert fix. AWS Cloud Practitioner appears under 'Relevant certifications (PREFERRED BUT NOT MANDATORY)' alongside AZ-900, SC-900, Security+ and ISC2 CC — so it is not a named requirement he unlocks, and passing it does not deliver IAM review, CSPM, SIEM, OS fundamentals or networking. 'One cert, two bullets' is not what the page says. What survives: it is genuinely Mumbai, genuinely the client-facing India entity, genuinely says early-career, and the degree gate passes — on a board where Mumbai openings he can even read are scarce. Keep it, ranked fourth and strictly conditional: there is zero analytics in this role, so he should only apply if he has decided he wants a cyber governance career, and he should decide that before he interviews.

honesty_check: Link audit: 7 of 7 live. All returned HTTP 200 with no redirect and all rendered genuine job-detail pages (verified by title tag pattern 'Job Details | deloitte' plus schema.org JobPosting metadata). Zero 404s, zero soft-404s to a generic search page, and — worth stating plainly because the brief asked for the distinction — zero 403s, so there is no bot-blocking ambiguity to report on any of these. Every one of the seven eligibility verdicts was overstated, and three of the seven collapse entirely on the posted text: 110508 (Power BI) is a client-account-ownership and people-management role whose work profile the original never quoted; 110723 (FT Strategy & Ops) is a full-stack SDE spec with a consulting title; 108566 (DEC Data Science) is an ML Engineer seat that expires on 2 Oct 2026, seven days out, which makes its own recommended 3-4 week remediation arithmetically impossible. What I could NOT verify, and am not going to pretend otherwise: (1) Deloitte India grade-to-years conventions — that Consultant means 2-4 years, that Senior Analyst sits above fresher — appear nowhere on any of these pages; that is my inference from market convention, not posted fact, and I have flagged it as inference rather than evidence. (2) Not one of these seven postings mentions internships, final-semester placements, deferred starts or 2027 graduate programmes anywhere in its text. The entire Jan-May 2027 internship strategy in the original write-ups is a proposal he would be making unprompted to recruiters, not an option any of these reqs advertises, and with the campus-hiring URL now erroring out there is no evidence Deloitte India is running a public student pipeline he can enter. (4) Whether any of these roles would actually wait until June 2027 is unknowable from the pages; reqs live only to Nov/Dec 2026 are being filled this quarter, which cuts against him.
